title: باب التَّرْغِيبِ فِي سُكْنَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَالصَّبْرِ عَلَى لأْوَائِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ وَهْىَ وَبِيئَةٌ فَاشْتَكَى أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَاشْتَكَى بِلاَلٌ فَلَمَّا رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَكْوَى أَصْحَابِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ كَمَا حَبَّبْتَ مَكَّةَ أَوْ أَشَدَّ وَصَحِّحْهَا وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِهَا وَمُدِّهَا وَحَوِّلْ حُمَّاهَا إِلَى الْجُحْفَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abdah narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. She said: We came to Madinah while it was unhealthy. Abu Bakr became ill and Bilal became ill. When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) saw the illness of his companions, he said: O Allah, make us love Madinah as You made us love Makkah, or more. Make it healthy for us, bless its sa and its mudd, and transfer its fever to al-Juhfah.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abdah überlieferte uns, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha. She said: We came to Medina while it was unhealthy. Abu Bakr became ill and Bilal became ill. When der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) saw the illness of his companions, he said: O Allah, make us love Medina as You made us love Makka, or more. Make it healthy for us, segne its sa and its mudd, and transfer its fever to al-Juhfah. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب التَّرْغِيبِ فِي سُكْنَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَالصَّبْرِ عَلَى لأْوَائِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَنْ صَبَرَ عَلَى لأْوَائِهَا كُنْتُ لَهُ شَفِيعًا أَوْ شَهِيدًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Uthman ibn Umar narrated to us. Isa ibn Hafs ibn Asim informed us. Nafi narrated to us, from Ibn Umar. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Whoever is patient through its hardship, I will be his intercessor or witness on the Day of Resurrection.
translation_de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Uthman ibn Umar überlieferte uns. Isa ibn Hafs ibn Asim berichtete uns. Nafi überlieferte uns, from Ibn Umar. Er sagte: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Whoever is patient through its Not, I will be his intercessor or witness on the Tag der Auferstehung. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب التَّرْغِيبِ فِي سُكْنَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَالصَّبْرِ عَلَى لأْوَائِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ قَطَنِ بْنِ وَهْبِ بْنِ عُوَيْمِرِ بْنِ، الأَجْدَعِ عَنْ يُحَنِّسَ، مَوْلَى الزُّبَيْرِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، كَانَ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ فِي الْفِتْنَةِ فَأَتَتْهُ مَوْلاَةٌ لَهُ تُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي أَرَدْتُ الْخُرُوجَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ اشْتَدَّ عَلَيْنَا الزَّمَانُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ اقْعُدِي لَكَاعِ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يَصْبِرُ عَلَى لأْوَائِهَا وَشِدَّتِهَا أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ كُنْتُ لَهُ شَهِيدًا أَوْ شَفِيعًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Qatan ibn Wahb ibn Uwaymir ibn al-Ajda, from Yuhannis, the freedman of al-Zubayr, who informed him that he was sitting with Abd Allah ibn Umar during the turmoil. A female servant of his came to greet him and said: I intend to leave, Abu Abd al-Rahman; times have become hard for us. Abd Allah said to her: Sit down, foolish woman. I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: No one is patient through its hardship and difficulty except that I will be his witness or intercessor on the Day of Resurrection.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Qatan ibn Wahb ibn Uwaymir ibn al-Ajda, from Yuhannis, the freedman of al-Zubayr, who informed him that he was sitting with Abd Allah ibn Umar during the turmoil. A female servant of his came to greet him and said: I intend to leave, Abu Abd al-Rahman; times have become hard for us. Abd Allah said to her: Sit down, foolish woman. I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: No one is patient through its Not and Schwierigkeit except that I will be his witness or intercessor on the Tag der Auferstehung. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، عَنْ قَطَنٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ يُحَنِّسَ، مَوْلَى مُصْعَبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَنْ صَبَرَ عَلَى لأْوَائِهَا وَشِدَّتِهَا كُنْتُ لَهُ شَهِيدًا أَوْ شَفِيعًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي الْمَدِينَةَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ibn Rafi narrated to us. Ibn Abi Fudayk informed us. Al-Dahhak informed us, from Qatan al-Khuza'i, from Yuhannis, the freedman of Musab, from Abd Allah ibn Umar. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Whoever is patient through its hardship and difficulty, I will be his witness or intercessor on the Day of Resurrection, meaning Madinah.

Er sagte: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Whoever is patient through its Not and Schwierigkeit, I will be his witness or intercessor on the Tag der Auferstehung, meaning Medina. title: باب التَّرْغِيبِ فِي سُكْنَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَالصَّبْرِ عَلَى لأْوَائِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَصْبِرُ عَلَى لأْوَاءِ الْمَدِينَةِ وَشِدَّتِهَا أَحَدٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي إِلاَّ كُنْتُ لَهُ شَفِيعًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَوْ شَهِيدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr narrated to us, all from Ismail ibn Ja'far, from al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: No one from my community is patient through the hardship and difficulty of Madinah except that I will be his intercessor on the Day of Resurrection or his witness.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr überlieferte uns, all from Ismail ibn Ja'far, from al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: No one from my community is patient through the Not and Schwierigkeit of Medina except that I will be his intercessor on the Tag der Auferstehung or his witness. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب التَّرْغِيبِ فِي سُكْنَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَالصَّبْرِ عَلَى لأْوَائِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي هَارُونَ، مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عِيسَى أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْقَرَّاظَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Harun, Musa ibn Abi Isa, who heard Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz say: I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said the same.
translation_de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Abu Harun, Musa ibn Abi Isa, who heard Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz say: I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said the same. reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1378 c, book 15, باب التَّرْغِيبِ فِي سُكْنَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَالصَّبْرِ عَلَى لأْوَائِهَا ‏‏
title: باب التَّرْغِيبِ فِي سُكْنَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَالصَّبْرِ عَلَى لأْوَائِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَصْبِرُ أَحَدٌ عَلَى لأْوَاءِ الْمَدِينَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yusuf ibn Isa narrated to us. Al-Fadl ibn Musa narrated to us. Hisham ibn Urwah informed us, from Salih ibn Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: No one is patient through the hardship of Madinah. He said the same.
translation_de: Yusuf ibn Isa überlieferte uns. Al-Fadl ibn Musa überlieferte uns. Hisham ibn Urwah berichtete uns, from Salih ibn Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: No one is patient through the Not of Medina. He said the same. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب صِيَانَةِ الْمَدِينَةِ مِنْ دُخُولِ الطَّاعُونِ وَالدَّجَّالِ إِلَيْهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عَلَى أَنْقَابِ الْمَدِينَةِ مَلاَئِكَةٌ لاَ يَدْخُلُهَا الطَّاعُونُ وَلاَ الدَّجَّالُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Nuaim ibn Abd Allah, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: At the entrances of Madinah are angels. Neither plague nor the Dajjal will enter it.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Nuaim ibn Abd Allah, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: At the entrances of Medina are Engel. Neither plague nor the Dajjal will enter it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب صِيَانَةِ الْمَدِينَةِ مِنْ دُخُولِ الطَّاعُونِ وَالدَّجَّالِ إِلَيْهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْعَلاَءُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَأْتِي الْمَسِيحُ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْمَشْرِقِ هِمَّتُهُ الْمَدِينَةُ حَتَّى يَنْزِلَ دُبُرَ أُحُدٍ ثُمَّ تَصْرِفُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَجْهَهُ قِبَلَ الشَّامِ وَهُنَالِكَ يَهْلِكُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr narrated to us, all from Ismail ibn Ja'far. Al-Ala informed me, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: The Messiah will come from the east, intending Madinah, until he descends behind Uhud. Then the angels will turn his face toward Syria, and there he will perish.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr überlieferte uns, all from Ismail ibn Ja'far. Al-Ala berichtete mir, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: The Messiah will come from the east, intending Medina, until he descends behind Uhud. Then the Engel will turn his face toward Syria, and there he will perish. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب الْمَدِينَةِ تَنْفِي شِرَارَهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَأْتِي عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ يَدْعُو الرَّجُلُ ابْنَ عَمِّهِ وَقَرِيبَهُ هَلُمَّ إِلَى الرَّخَاءِ هَلُمَّ إِلَى الرَّخَاءِ وَالْمَدِينَةُ خَيْرٌ لَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لاَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدٌ رَغْبَةً عَنْهَا إِلاَّ أَخْلَفَ اللَّهُ فِيهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ أَلاَ إِنَّ الْمَدِينَةَ كَالْكِيرِ تُخْرِجُ الْخَبِيثَ ‏.‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى تَنْفِيَ الْمَدِينَةُ شِرَارَهَا كَمَا يَنْفِي الْكِيرُ خَبَثَ الْحَدِيدِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Abd al-Aziz, meaning al-Darawardi, narrated to us, from al-Ala, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A time will come upon people when a man will call his cousin and relative, saying: Come to prosperity, come to prosperity. Madinah is better for them, if they knew. By the One in whose hand is my soul, no one leaves it out of dislike for it except that Allah replaces him there with someone better than him. Madinah is like a furnace: it removes the impure. The Hour will not come until Madinah expels its wicked people as a furnace expels the impurities of iron.
translation_de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Abd al-Aziz, meaning al-Darawardi, überlieferte uns, from al-Ala, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: A time will come upon people when a man will call his cousin and relative, saying: Come to prosperity, come to prosperity. Medina is better for them, if they knew. By the One in whose hand is my soul, no one leaves it out of dislike for it except that Allah replaces him there with someone better than him. Medina is like a furnace: it removes the impure. The Hour will not come until Medina expels its wicked people as a furnace expels the impurities of iron. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب الْمَدِينَةِ تَنْفِي شِرَارَهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، - فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ - عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ، سَعِيدٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْحُبَابِ، سَعِيدَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أُمِرْتُ بِقَرْيَةٍ تَأْكُلُ الْقُرَى يَقُولُونَ يَثْرِبَ وَهْىَ الْمَدِينَةُ تَنْفِي النَّاسَ كَمَا يَنْفِي الْكِيرُ خَبَثَ الْحَدِيدِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Malik ibn Anas, as it was read to him, from Yahya ibn Sa'id. He said: I heard Abu al-Hubab, Sa'id ibn Yasar, say: I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I was commanded regarding a city that consumes cities. They call it Yathrib, but it is Madinah. It expels people as a furnace expels the impurities of iron.
translation_de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Malik ibn Anas, as it was read to him, from Yahya ibn Sa'id. Er sagte: I heard Abu al-Hubab, Sa'id ibn Yasar, say: I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I was commanded regarding a city that consumes cities. They call it Yathrib, but it is Medina. It expels people as a furnace expels the impurities of iron. title: باب الْمَدِينَةِ تَنْفِي شِرَارَهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالاَ ‏"‏ كَمَا يَنْفِي الْكِيرُ الْخَبَثَ "‏ ‏.‏ لَمْ يَذْكُرَا الْحَدِيدَ .
translation_en: Amr al-Naqid and Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. They said: Sufyan narrated to us. H; Ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us. All of them narrated from Yahya ibn Sa'id, with this chain. They said: As a furnace expels impurity. They did not mention iron.
translation_de: Amr al-Naqid and Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. They said: Sufyan überlieferte uns. H; Ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Abd al-Wahhab überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Yahya ibn Sa'id, with this chain. They said: As a furnace expels impurity. They did not mention iron. reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1383, book 15, باب الْمَدِينَةِ تَنْفِي شِرَارَهَا ‏‏
title: باب الْمَدِينَةِ تَنْفِي شِرَارَهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا، بَايَعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَصَابَ الأَعْرَابِيَّ وَعَكٌ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ أَقِلْنِي بَيْعَتِي ‏.‏ فَأَبَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ فَقَالَ أَقِلْنِي بَيْعَتِي ‏.‏ فَأَبَى ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ فَقَالَ أَقِلْنِي بَيْعَتِي ‏.‏ فَأَبَى فَخَرَجَ الأَعْرَابِيُّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا الْمَدِينَةُ كَالْكِيرِ تَنْفِي خَبَثَهَا وَيَنْصَعُ طَيِّبُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, that a desert Arab pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). A fever struck him in Madinah, so he came to the Prophet (peace be upon him) and said: Muhammad, release me from my pledge. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) refused. He came again and said it, and he refused. He came a third time and said it, and he refused. The desert Arab then left. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Madinah is like a furnace; it removes its impurities and makes its good pure.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, that a desert Arab pledged allegiance to der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). A fever struck him in Medina, so he came to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) and said: Muhammad, release me from my pledge. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) refused. He came again and said it, and he refused. He came a third time and said it, and he refused. The desert Arab then left. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Medina is like a furnace; it removes its impurities and makes its good pure. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1384, book 15, باب الْمَدِينَةِ تَنْفِي شِرَارَهَا ‏‏
title: باب الْمَدِينَةِ تَنْفِي شِرَارَهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، - وَهُوَ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَابِتٍ - سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا طَيْبَةُ - يَعْنِي الْمَدِينَةَ - وَإِنَّهَا تَنْفِي الْخَبَثَ كَمَا تَنْفِي النَّارُ خَبَثَ الْفِضَّةِ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh, al-Anbari, narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from Adi, Ibn Thabit, who heard Abd Allah ibn Yazid, from Zayd ibn Thabit, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: It is good, meaning Madinah, and it removes impurity as fire removes the impurity of silver.
translation_de: Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh, al-Anbari, überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns, from Adi, Ibn Thabit, who heard Abd Allah ibn Yazid, from Zayd ibn Thabit, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: It is good, meaning Medina, and it removes impurity as fire removes the impurity of silver. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1385, book 15, باب الْمَدِينَةِ تَنْفِي شِرَارَهَا ‏‏
title: باب الْمَدِينَةِ تَنْفِي شِرَارَهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَهَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى سَمَّى الْمَدِينَةَ طَابَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, Hannad ibn al-Sari, and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah said: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from Simak, from Jabir ibn Samurah. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Allah Most High named Madinah Tabah.
translation_de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, Hannad ibn al-Sari, and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah said: Abu al-Ahwas überlieferte uns, from Simak, from Jabir ibn Samurah. Er sagte: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Allah Most High named Medina Tabah. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1386 a, book 15, باب مَنْ أَرَادَ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ بِسُوءٍ أَذَابَهُ اللَّهُ ‏‏
title: باب مَنْ أَرَادَ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ بِسُوءٍ أَذَابَهُ اللَّهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ يُحَنِّسَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْقَرَّاظِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ عَلَى أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ أَرَادَ أَهْلَ هَذِهِ الْبَلْدَةِ بِسُوءٍ - يَعْنِي الْمَدِينَةَ - أَذَابَهُ اللَّهُ كَمَا يَذُوبُ الْمِلْحُ فِي الْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Hatim and Ibrahim ibn Dinar narrated to me. They said: Hajjaj ibn Muhammad narrated to us. H; Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Both narrated from Ibn Jurayj. Abd Allah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Yuhannis informed me, from Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz, that he said: I testify concerning Abu Hurayra that he said: Abu al-Qasim (peace be upon him) said: Whoever intends evil for the people of this city, meaning Madinah, Allah will melt him as salt melts in water.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Hatim and Ibrahim ibn Dinar überlieferte mir. They said: Hajjaj ibn Muhammad überlieferte uns. H; Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte mir. Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. Both narrated from Ibn Jurayj. Abd Allah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Yuhannis berichtete mir, from Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz, that he said: I testify concerning Abu Hurayra that he said: Abu al-Qasim (peace be upon him) said: Whoever intends Böses for the people of this city, meaning Medina, Allah will melt him as Salz melts in Wasser. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب مَنْ أَرَادَ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ بِسُوءٍ أَذَابَهُ اللَّهُ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُمَارَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْقَرَّاظَ، - وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ - يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ أَرَادَ أَهْلَهَا بِسُوءٍ - يُرِيدُ الْمَدِينَةَ - أَذَابَهُ اللَّهُ كَمَا يَذُوبُ الْمِلْحُ فِي الْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ فِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ يُحَنِّسَ بَدَلَ قَوْلِهِ بِسُوءٍ شَرًّا‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Hatim and Ibrahim ibn Dinar narrated to me. They said: Hajjaj narrated to us. H; Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated it to me. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. All narrated from Ibn Jurayj, who said: Amr ibn Yahya ibn Umarah informed me that he heard al-Qarraz, one of the companions of Abu Hurayra, claim that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever intends evil for its people, meaning Madinah, Allah will melt him as salt melts in water. Ibn Hatim's hadith says 'evil' instead of 'harm'.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Hatim and Ibrahim ibn Dinar überlieferte mir. They said: Hajjaj überlieferte uns. H; Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated it to me. Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. All narrated from Ibn Jurayj, who said: Amr ibn Yahya ibn Umarah berichtete mir that he heard al-Qarraz, one of the companions of Abu Hurayra, claim that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever intends Böses for its people, meaning Medina, Allah will melt him as Salz melts in Wasser. Ibn Hatim's hadith says 'Böses' instead of 'harm'. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب مَنْ أَرَادَ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ بِسُوءٍ أَذَابَهُ اللَّهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي هَارُونَ، مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عِيسَى ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا الدَّرَاوَرْدِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، جَمِيعًا سَمِعَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، الْقَرَّاظَ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Harun, Musa ibn Abi Isa. H; Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Al-Darawardi narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Amr. Both heard Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz hear Abu Hurayra from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning.
translation_de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Abu Harun, Musa ibn Abi Isa. H; Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Al-Darawardi überlieferte uns, from Muhammad ibn Amr. Both heard Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz hear Abu Hurayra from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning. title: باب مَنْ أَرَادَ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ بِسُوءٍ أَذَابَهُ اللَّهُ ‏‏

title: باب مَنْ أَرَادَ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ بِسُوءٍ أَذَابَهُ اللَّهُ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ نُبَيْهٍ، الْكَعْبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْقَرَّاظِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعْدَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِدَهْمٍ أَوْ بِسُوءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Ismail, meaning Ibn Ja'far, narrated to us, from Umar ibn Nubayh al-Ka'bi, from Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz, that he heard Sa'd ibn Malik say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said the same, except that he said: with harm or evil.

title: باب مَنْ أَرَادَ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ بِسُوءٍ أَذَابَهُ اللَّهُ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْقَرَّاظِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، وَسَعْدًا، يَقُولاَنِ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ فِي مُدِّهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَفِيهِ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَرَادَ أَهْلَهَا بِسُوءٍ أَذَابَهُ اللَّهُ كَمَا يَذُوبُ الْمِلْحُ فِي الْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Ubayd Allah ibn Musa narrated to us. Usamah ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Abu Abd Allah al-Qarraz. He said: I heard him say: I heard Abu Hurayra and Sa'd say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: O Allah, bless the people of Madinah in their mudd. Then he related the hadith, including: Whoever intends evil for its people, Allah will melt him as salt melts in water.

Er sagte: I heard him say: I heard Abu Hurayra and Sa'd say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: O Allah, segne the people of Medina in their mudd. Then he related the hadith, including: Whoever intends Böses for its people, Allah will melt him as Salz melts in Wasser. title: باب التَّرْغِيبِ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ عِنْدَ فَتْحِ الأَمْصَارِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ أَبِي زُهَيْرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يُفْتَحُ الشَّامُ فَيَخْرُجُ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ قَوْمٌ بِأَهْلِيهِمْ يَبُسُّونَ وَالْمَدِينَةُ خَيْرٌ لَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ ثُمَّ يُفْتَحُ الْيَمَنُ فَيَخْرُجُ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ قَوْمٌ بِأَهْلِيهِمْ يَبُسُّونَ وَالْمَدِينَةُ خَيْرٌ لَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ ثُمَّ يُفْتَحُ الْعِرَاقُ فَيَخْرُجُ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ قَوْمٌ بِأَهْلِيهِمْ يَبُسُّونَ وَالْمَدِينَةُ خَيْرٌ لَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Waki narrated to us, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr, from Sufyan ibn Abi Zuhayr. Then Yemen will be conquered, and people will leave Madinah with their families seeking easy living, while Madinah is better for them, if they knew. Then Iraq will be conquered, and people will leave Madinah with their families seeking easy living, while Madinah is better for them, if they knew.

Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Syria will be conquered, and people will leave Medina with their families seeking easy living, while Medina is better for them, if they knew. Then Yemen will be conquered, and people will leave Medina with their families seeking easy living, while Medina is better for them, if they knew. Then Iraq will be conquered, and people will leave Medina with their families seeking easy living, while Medina is better for them, if they knew. text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي هِشَامُ، بْنُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ أَبِي زُهَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ يُفْتَحُ الْيَمَنُ فَيَأْتِي قَوْمٌ يَبُسُّونَ فَيَتَحَمَّلُونَ بِأَهْلِيهِمْ وَمَنْ أَطَاعَهُمْ وَالْمَدِينَةُ خَيْرٌ لَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ ثُمَّ يُفْتَحُ الشَّامُ فَيَأْتِي قَوْمٌ يَبُسُّونَ فَيَتَحَمَّلُونَ بِأَهْلِيهِمْ وَمَنْ أَطَاعَهُمْ وَالْمَدِينَةُ خَيْرٌ لَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ ثُمَّ يُفْتَحُ الْعِرَاقُ فَيَأْتِي قَوْمٌ يَبُسُّونَ فَيَتَحَمَّلُونَ بِأَهْلِيهِمْ وَمَنْ أَطَاعَهُمْ وَالْمَدِينَةُ خَيْرٌ لَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to us. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ibn Jurayj informed us, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr, from Sufyan ibn Abi Zuhayr, who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Yemen will be conquered, and people will come seeking easy living, taking their families and whoever obeys them with them, while Madinah is better for them, if they knew. reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1389 a, book 15, باب فِي الْمَدِينَةِ حِينَ يَتْرُكُهَا أَهْلُهَا ‏‏
title: باب فِي الْمَدِينَةِ حِينَ يَتْرُكُهَا أَهْلُهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَفْوَانَ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ، بْنُ يَحْيَى - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ، الْمُسَيَّبِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلْمَدِينَةِ ‏"‏ لَيَتْرُكَنَّهَا أَهْلُهَا عَلَى خَيْرِ مَا كَانَتْ مُذَلَّلَةً لِلْعَوَافِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي السِّبَاعَ وَالطَّيْرَ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ أَبُو صَفْوَانَ هَذَا هُوَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ يَتِيمُ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ كَانَ فِي حَجْرِهِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Abu Safwan narrated to us, from Yunus ibn Yazid. H; Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me, and this is his wording. Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, who heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said of Madinah: Its people will leave it in the best state it ever had, leaving it to the animals, meaning predators and birds. Muslim said: Abu Safwan was Abd Allah ibn Abd al-Malik, the orphan of Ibn Jurayj, who had been in his care for ten years.

Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, who heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said of Medina: Its people will leave it in the best state it ever had, leaving it to the animals, meaning predators and birds. title: باب فِي الْمَدِينَةِ حِينَ يَتْرُكُهَا أَهْلُهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ، خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ يَتْرُكُونَ الْمَدِينَةَ عَلَى خَيْرِ مَا كَانَتْ لاَ يَغْشَاهَا إِلاَّ الْعَوَافِي - يُرِيدُ عَوَافِيَ السِّبَاعِ وَالطَّيْرِ - ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ رَاعِيَانِ مِنْ مُزَيْنَةَ يُرِيدَانِ الْمَدِينَةَ يَنْعِقَانِ بِغَنَمِهِمَا فَيَجِدَانِهَا وَحْشًا حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَا ثَنِيَّةَ الْوَدَاعِ خَرَّا عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abd al-Malik ibn Shuayb ibn al-Layth narrated to me. My father narrated to me, from my grandfather. Uqayl ibn Khalid narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib informed me that Abu Hurayra said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: They will leave Madinah in the best state it ever had; only the animals will approach it, meaning predators and birds. Then two shepherds from Muzaynah will head toward Madinah, calling to their sheep. They will find it deserted, and when they reach the mountain pass of al-Wada, they will fall upon their faces.
translation_de: Abd al-Malik ibn Shuayb ibn al-Layth überlieferte mir. My father überlieferte mir, from my grandfather. Uqayl ibn Khalid überlieferte mir, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib berichtete mir that Abu Hurayra said: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: They will leave Medina in the best state it ever had; only the animals will approach it, meaning predators and birds. title: باب مَا بَيْنَ الْقَبْرِ وَالْمِنْبَرِ رَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي، بَكْرٍ عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الْمَازِنِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَيْنَ بَيْتِي وَمِنْبَرِي رَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Malik ibn Anas, as it was read to him, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr, from Abbad ibn Tamim, from Abd Allah ibn Zayd al-Mazini, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Between my house and my pulpit is a garden from the gardens of Paradise.
translation_de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Malik ibn Anas, as it was read to him, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr, from Abbad ibn Tamim, from Abd Allah ibn Zayd al-Mazini, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Between my Haus and my Kanzel is a garden from the gardens of Paradies. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب مَا بَيْنَ الْقَبْرِ وَالْمِنْبَرِ رَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمَدَنِيُّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَا بَيْنَ مِنْبَرِي وَبَيْتِي رَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad al-Madani informed us, from Yazid ibn al-Had, from Abu Bakr, from Abbad ibn Tamim, from Abd Allah ibn Zayd al-Ansari, that he heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Between my pulpit and my house is a garden from the gardens of Paradise.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad al-Madani berichtete uns, from Yazid ibn al-Had, from Abu Bakr, from Abbad ibn Tamim, from Abd Allah ibn Zayd al-Ansari, that he heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Between my Kanzel and my Haus is a garden from the gardens of Paradies. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب مَا بَيْنَ الْقَبْرِ وَالْمِنْبَرِ رَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ، بْنِ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَيْنَ بَيْتِي وَمِنْبَرِي رَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ وَمِنْبَرِي عَلَى حَوْضِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. They said: Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah. H; Ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Ubayd Allah narrated to us, from Khubayb ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Hafs ibn Asim, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Between my house and my pulpit is a garden from the gardens of Paradise, and my pulpit is upon my basin.
translation_de: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. They said: Yahya ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah. H; Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah überlieferte uns, from Khubayb ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Hafs ibn Asim, from Abu Hurayra, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Between my Haus and my Kanzel is a garden from the gardens of Paradies, and my Kanzel is upon my basin. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1392, book 15, باب أُحُدٌ جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏‏
title: باب أُحُدٌ جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَفِيهِ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلْنَا حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا وَادِيَ الْقُرَى فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنِّي مُسْرِعٌ فَمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ فَلْيُسْرِعْ مَعِي وَمَنْ شَاءَ فَلْيَمْكُثْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَخَرَجْنَا حَتَّى أَشْرَفْنَا عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذِهِ طَابَةُ وَهَذَا أُحُدٌ وَهُوَ جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah al-Qanabi narrated to us. Sulayman ibn Bilal narrated to us, from Amr ibn Yahya, from Abbas ibn Sahl al-Sa'idi, from Abu Humayd. He said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on the expedition to Tabuk. He related the hadith, including: We came to Wadi al-Qura, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I am going ahead quickly. Whoever wishes may go quickly with me, and whoever wishes may remain behind. We went on until Madinah came into view, and he said: This is Tabah, and this is Uhud, a mountain that loves us and we love it.
translation_de: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah al-Qanabi überlieferte uns. Sulayman ibn Bilal überlieferte uns, from Amr ibn Yahya, from Abbas ibn Sahl al-Sa'idi, from Abu Humayd. Er sagte: We went out with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) on the expedition to Tabuk. He related the hadith, including: We came to Wadi al-Qura, and der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: I am going ahead quickly. Whoever wishes may go quickly with me, and whoever wishes may remain behind. We went on until Medina came into view, and he said: This is Tabah, and this is Uhud, a Berg that loves us and we love it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.
